# codeint

> codeint is a command-line tool, local MCP server, and programmatic SDK (JavaScript/TypeScript and Rust) that measures Software entropy (Erosion, Cognitive complexity, Test gap, Duplication with Clone families and opt-in near-clones, Verbosity, Import cycles, Import boundaries, Orphan files, and Dependency hygiene) and reports Hazards next to Software entropy across TypeScript/JavaScript (including React JSX/TSX, Vue, and Svelte), Rust, PHP, Dart, Python, Go, SQL (generic SQL plus PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, and DuckDB Dialects), and external WebAssembly Language and Metric plugins.
> CLI commands include `check`, `diff`, `ratchet`, `trend`, `impact`, `trace`, `guard`, `churn`, `coupling`, `report`, `config`, `schema`, `doctor`, `agent`, `mcp`, `init`, and `update`, configured via `codeint.json`, `codeint.jsonc`, `.codeint/config.json`, or `.codeint/config.jsonc`, with optional whole-repository ceilings in `.codeint/ratchet.json`.

## Guide

- [Guide Index](docs/guide/README.md): reading map for all user documentation.
- [Philosophy and Architecture](docs/guide/philosophy-and-architecture.md): why Software entropy matters, how all independent Metrics (including Hazards) and structural checks work, and how the codebase is structured.
- [Getting Started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install codeint, initialize `codeint.jsonc`, and run `check`, `diff`, `ratchet update`, `trend`, `doctor`, `config`, `report`, `guard`, `trace`, `impact`, `churn`, `coupling`, and `update`.
- [Configuration](docs/guide/configuration.md): configure `codeint.json`, `codeint.jsonc`, `.codeint/config.json`, or `.codeint/config.jsonc` Budgets, new-file Budgets, Regression limits (including opt-in `per_file` checks), Ratchet path, Source sets, architectural boundaries, near-clones, entry points, dependency hygiene, Coverage reports, SQL Dialects, Hazards disabled rules, and multi-language folders, plus `codeint config --resolved`.
- [Import boundaries](docs/guide/import-boundaries.md): define architectural zones, `public_files` encapsulation, built-in `layered` and `hexagonal` presets, `allow_external` and `deny_external` third-party package glob rules, and pre-edit `codeint guard` checks.
- [Test gap](docs/guide/test-gap.md): measure untested Production Function mass from LCOV and Cobertura XML Coverage reports, set up each test tool, and enforce a Test gap Budget.
- [Hazards](docs/guide/hazards.md): measure Hazard lines next to Software entropy with strict non-leakage, disable named rules, and enforce Budgets and Regression limits.
- [Built-in Languages](docs/guide/languages.md): TypeScript/JavaScript/Vue/Svelte, Rust, PHP, Dart, Python, Go, and SQL rules, function names, cognitive complexity, manifests, and calibrated Reference ranges.
- [Go Guide](docs/guide/go.md): Go terminology mapping, Source sets, Flagged line rules, multi-file Go package imports, entry points, and `go.mod` Dependency hygiene.
- [SQL Guide](docs/guide/sql.md): generic SQL measurement, PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite/DuckDB Dialects, Source sets, templated SQL and rejected statements, and automatic SQL Schema rules.
- [CI and GitHub Actions](docs/guide/ci-and-github-actions.md): reusable GitHub Action, single-scan multi-format `codeint report` workflows, `CODEOWNERS` `--owner` filtering, `--package` scoping, and SARIF upload.
- [Coding-Agent Integration (MCP Server)](docs/guide/mcp.md): automatic `codeint agent status`/`install`, `codeint schema`, and local stdio MCP server (`codeint mcp`) exposing `check`, `diff`, `trend`, `guard`, `impact`, `trace`, `churn`, and `coupling`.

## Reference and APIs

- [CLI and Configuration Reference](docs/reference.md): tested reference for every command, flag, exit code, report format (`toon`, `json`, `sarif`, `markdown`, `text`), and schema key.
- [Programmatic API](docs/programmatic.md): JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (`codeint` npm package) and Rust library API (`codeint-cli`).
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): build, hash, declare, and test external WebAssembly Language and Metric plugins against `codeint:plugin@0.4.0`.
- [JSON Schema](schema/codeint.schema.json): JSON Schema for `codeint.jsonc` and `codeint.json`.
- [Glossary](GLOSSARY.md): canonical domain terminology.
- [Evaluation suite runner](eval/HOW-TO.md): measure the pinned public corpus in `eval/corpus.json` in scratch folders with native-parser recall oracles, 3-run timing, and peak memory.
